## AI Adoption Stalled by “Information Tax” in Financial Services: Iron Mountain Advances InSight DXP to Bridge the Data-to-AI Gap


November 16, 2026


*New Iron Mountain research reveals only 34% of financial services content is connected across systems, exposing manual operation burdens; latest Iron Mountain InSight® DXP innovations bring greater connectivity and control, grounding AI in trusted business context*


PORTSMOUTH, N.H.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Financial services and insurance (FSI) organizations report stronger average gains than their cross-industry peers: 32% higher in IT efficiency and 21% higher in AI readiness. Yet this performance risks masking a heavy “information tax,” the compounding cost of wasted labor, delayed decision-making, and stalled AI initiatives caused by fragmented data. Today, alongside[new global research](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fresources.ironmountain.com%2Fwhitepapers%2Fb%2Fbreaking-the-data-ceiling-in-financial-services-a-path-to-ai-at-scale%3Futm_source%3DDBU_research_%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease%26localize%3Dfalse&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=new+global+research&index=1&md5=818d36da557c2bd2488e796b70055baa) exposing these operational bottlenecks,[Iron Mountain](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=Iron+Mountain&index=2&md5=8b0455c5efba2e55315a65de243bbdee) (NYSE: IRM), a global leader in information management services, introduced the latest release of Iron Mountain InSight® DXP, delivering automated content intelligence and governance to help institutions eliminate manual data burdens and operationalize enterprise AI. According to the global research, outperforming industry averages may create a false sense of security for banks and insurers: 89% of FSI organizations admit that legacy enterprise content management (ECM) costs directly limit their ability to invest in AI and modernization.


Facing zero-tolerance regulatory frameworks, 96% of financial institutions report the need for manual intervention to prepare unstructured data for AI workflows. Furthermore, 84% agree that highly skilled IT and data science talent is diverted from strategic innovation to routine data tasks—with nearly half (45%) citing[data classification and tagging](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com%2Fservices%2Finsight-digital-experience-platform%2Fintelligent-document-processing%3Futm_source%3DPress_Release%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease%26utm_content%3DDBU_Research_Release&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=data+classification+and+tagging&index=3&md5=fc02406964ccf780a51f0abe159e40c7) as a primary manual burden.


“Financial services firms are investing heavily in AI, but paying a steep operational tax to feed those models trusted, reliable information,” said Varun Gupta, Senior Vice President, Global Product & Solutions Marketing at Iron Mountain. “Connecting that information, preserving its business context and embedding governance into workflows are essential to scaling AI with confidence. To unlock AI’s full potential, financial institutions need a unified content intelligence layer that automates governance and structures dark data at ingestion so models and agents can act on reliable data. In today’s AI era, your underlying data foundation is just as critical as the AI technology itself."


For 75 years, Iron Mountain has continuously evolved to meet changing customer needs, growing from the trusted guardian of physical records into a global leader in digital transformation and AI-ready information management. Building on that legacy, Iron Mountain announced the latest release of Iron Mountain InSight DXP,[an AI-powered intelligent content platform](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com%2Fservices%2Finsight-digital-experience-platform%3Futm_source%3DKuwait_JV_PR%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=an+AI-powered+intelligent+content+platform&index=4&md5=37aba6095a5a7cf44c3d36fb7ab1e4d0) built for enterprise trust. The release brings enterprise information and business systems closer together, reducing the manual effort required to turn fragmented content into trusted, actionable intelligence. By grounding AI in business context and strengthening governance across information and workflows, InSight DXP helps FSI clients move from isolated AI initiatives toward connected, accountable execution, accelerating decisions while maintaining control over the information behind them. Across document-heavy workflows, these contextual capabilities power InSight DXP solutions like[Digital Trade Back Office](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com%2Findustries%2Ffinancial-services%2Fdigital-trade-back-office%3Futm_source%3DPress_Release%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease%26utm_content%3DDBU_Research_Release&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=Digital+Trade+Back+Office&index=5&md5=6af929d79496ad724b89d9785540c8e8) ,[Digital Mortgage](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fresources.ironmountain.com%2Fsolution-guides%2Ft%2Ftransform-your-mortgage-process%3Futm_source%3DDBU_research_%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease%26localize%3Dfalse&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=Digital+Mortgage&index=6&md5=0208b6bd3c05c86a7614ef7a7d3da0e3) and[Digital Commercial Lending](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com%2Findustries%2Ffinancial-services%2Fdigital-commercial-lending%3Futm_source%3DDBU_research_%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=Digital+Commercial+Lending&index=7&md5=e9b3529f99cb124f09d71947296e1ae3) , achieving over 96% extraction accuracy on complex financial instruments and over 99% accuracy with human-in-the-loop (HITL) review.


The latest release of InSight DXP will be available worldwide this month. Learn more about[Iron Mountain InSight DXP](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ironmountain.com%2Fservices%2Finsight-digital-experience-platform%3Futm_source%3DKuwait_JV_PR%26utm_medium%3Dhyperlink%26utm_campaign%3D2026_GLOBAL_PRF_BRND_BZW_PressRelease&esheet=54640980&newsitemid=20261116479125&lan=en-US&anchor=Iron+Mountain+InSight+DXP&index=8&md5=2f4bdd459111af91f990a4995b23467b) .


***Research methodology*** *Iron Mountain commissioned independent market research specialist Vanson Bourne to survey 400 IT and data leaders globally across the U.S., UK, Germany, Brazil, India, and Australia. The research spanned public and private sectors—including banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare and life sciences, technology, manufacturing, and the public sector—with a dedicated cohort of 134 financial services and insurance decision-makers analyzed for this report. All respondents represented organizations with 1,000 or more employees.*
